h: Blessing the New Month and Gathering Scattered Holiness

p: In the blessing of the month,
on the Shabbos before Rosh Chodesh,
we say, "He who performed miracles for our fathers
For the first mitzvah at the Exodus from Egypt
was the sanctification of the month,
and there it was given only to Moshe and Aharon,
וְאַחַר כָּךְ נִתְּנָה גַּם לִגְדוֹלֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל
and afterward it was given also to the great ones of Yisrael
who left none like him in Eretz Yisrael,
on the Shabbos before Rosh Chodesh
that will come in the weekdays after it,
as we have said several times
this was given over to all of Yisrael,
And we begin, "He who performed miracles," etc.,
from the four corners of the earth";
and in the text of the prayer in Shemoneh Esrei,
in the blessing "Sound the great shofar,"
And it is stated in the name of the holy Ari
to the rectification of the blemish of the covenant;
for the letters before the last ones
"He has swallowed down riches and shall vomit them up" (Iyov 20:15);
for the rectification of this blemish
there is needed a shining forth from the aspect of Da'as,
which is the inwardness of Keser.
For the root of the evil inclination
is the evil inclination of lust;
I created the Torah as its antidote."
הַיְינוּ שֶׁהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ בָּרָא בָּאָדָם יֵצֶר
That is, Hashem Yisbarach created in man an inclination,
which is a term for longing,
with the intent that his longing and desire be
only for words of Torah, always;
and this will remain also in the future,
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ (זֹהַר חֵלֶק א קלח, א)
"Were it not for the evil inclination,
there would be no joy in learning."
And this is what it said:
"and I created the Torah as its antidote,"
to draw this longing toward words of Torah;
לָמָּה תִּינוֹק הָיִיתָ וְלֹא חָטָאתָ וְכוּלֵּי
"Why? You were a child and did not sin," etc.
And this is what it says (Bereishis 8:21):
כִּי יֵצֶר לֵב הָאָדָם רַע מִנְּעוּרָיו
"For the inclination of man's heart is evil from his youth";
and our Sages, of blessed memory, expounded:
to come out of his mother's womb.
And likewise they said in the Gemara (Sanhedrin 91b):
וְאַף שֶׁאָז אֵינוֹ יוֹדֵעַ מִשּׁוּם רַע
And although at that time he knows nothing of evil,
only the longing was created in him
that is, so that he have desire for the Torah;
one must rectify the entire blemish,
so that this inclination be nullified entirely,
וְיִהְיֶה בִּלַּע הַמָּוֶת לָנֶצַח (יְשַׁעְיָה כה, ח)
and "He will swallow up death forever" (Yeshayahu 25:8),
only as desire for the Torah.
וְלָכֵן אָמְרוּ בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק א ריט, ב)
Therefore they said in the holy Zohar (Zohar I 219b):
That is, to rectify through teshuvah,
which is the aspect of Binah
צָרִיךְ שֶׁיְּתוּקַּן עַד הַשּׁוֹרֶשׁ מִכֹּל וָכֹל
it must be rectified to the root, entirely.
that through the power of the Torah
there is rectification even for this blemish,
for the Torah, which is the aspect of Chochmah,
בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא יִתָּקַע בְּשׁוֹפָר גָּדוֹל וְגוֹמֵר
"On that day a great shofar shall be blown," etc.,
"and the dispersed in the land of Egypt";
that is, those who are sunk
שֶׁמִּצְרַיִם נִקְרָא עֶרְוַת הָאָרֶץ (בְּרֵאשִׁית מב, ט)
for Egypt is called "the nakedness of the land" (Bereishis 42:9).
And for this was the Egyptian exile,
And we begin the blessing in Shemoneh Esrei:
"and gather us together from the four corners,"
that is, to rectify to the root
And likewise on Rosh Chodesh we say in Musaf:
"Roshei Chodashim You gave to Your people,
a time of atonement for all their offspring";
הַיְינוּ גַּם כֵּן לְתַקֵּן הַיֵּצֶר הָרָע הַזֶּה
also to rectify this evil inclination,
"the inclination of man's heart is evil from his youth";
to rectify everything to the root,
and the light of the moon will be like the light of the sun,
as it was at the beginning,
Therefore on the Shabbos before Rosh Chodesh
שֶׁבְּשַׁבָּת יֵשׁ גַּם כֵּן הִתְגַּלּוּת עַתִּיקָא
for on Shabbos there is also the revelation of Atika,
and in the second prayer of Shabbos
we say, "Moshe rejoiced in the gift of his portion,"
וּמֹשֶׁה רַבֵּינוּ הוּא סוֹד הַדַּעַת כַּיָּדוּעַ
and Moshe Rabbeinu is the secret of Da'as, as is known;
and Shabbos, it is stated in the holy Zohar,
is in the secret of the covenant;
and then is also the time
Therefore on the Shabbos before Rosh Chodesh,
in which is included the holiness of Rosh Chodesh
which is for this rectification, as mentioned above,
we say in the blessing of the month:
from the four corners of the earth,"
"and the dispersed in the land of Egypt."
And Shabbos is a semblance of the World to Come,
"Three He gave a taste in this world
from what is written "bakol, mikol, kol";
that the evil inclination did not rule over them,
and that the Angel of Death did not rule over them
which is a semblance of the World to Come:
But the world is judged according to its majority;
to rectify everything to the root.

paragraphs.text: Source: Bava Basra 17a — “תנו רבנן: ששה לא שלט בהן מלאך המות, ואלו הן: אברהם, יצחק ויעקב, משה, אהרן ומרים. אברהם, יצחק ויעקב – דכתיב בהו: ״בכל״, ״מכל״, ״כל״; משה, אהרן ומרים – דכתיב …” (Oz Vehadar print, p. 43) — “The Sages taught: There were six people over whom the Angel of Death had no sway in their demise, and they are: Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, Moses, Aaron, and Miriam. Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, as it is written with regard …”
